p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6e51a2b6.py')

p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # The vertical separator marks the left raster; the paired panel on the
    # right supplies sparse 6 markers, which are projected onto the left.
    sep = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 7)
    width = sep
    out = [[6] * width for _ in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(width):
            if c + sep + 1 < len(row) and row[c] == 6 and row[c + sep + 1] == 6:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
''')
